A free AI readiness assessment and AI maturity assessment for enterprise and growing teams. Evaluate your organization across 5 critical pillars - data, technology, people, process, and strategy.
What Is an AI Readiness Assessment?

An AI readiness assessment measures how prepared your organization is to adopt artificial intelligence across five pillars: data, technology, people, process, and strategy. Instead of guessing whether you are ready to invest in AI, this free assessment gives you a scored, evidence-based answer in about 10 minutes.

An enterprise AI readiness assessment has to go further than a single team's tooling. It needs to account for governance across business units, data silos between departments, and alignment across a full leadership team, not just one project sponsor. This tool applies the same 5-pillar framework at that scale, so a division lead or CIO can benchmark multiple business units against one consistent standard.
AI Readiness vs. AI Maturity Assessment

"AI readiness" and "AI maturity assessment" are often used interchangeably, but they answer slightly different questions. Readiness asks whether you are prepared to start. Maturity asks how far along you already are. This tool covers both: it scores your current maturity level (Beginner through Leader) with a pillar-by-pillar breakdown, then generates a 90-day action plan to close the gaps it finds.
